rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation confirms an aggregate under-extraction. The March 31, 2026 debt schedule lists UBS fair value of $314.633 million and Wells fair value of $550.015 million, and its total row reports $864.648 million. The flagged output is approximately $431 million, a $433.648 million shortfall and about half the filing total. The raw schedule therefore decides that the output is wrong, although the evidence does not identify a single output-side culprit row or the exact transformation that produced $431 million.
